The '''Jran''' were small [[Sentience/Legends|Non-sentient]] predators which preyed on the tiny [[Wenton (creature)|Wenton]] creatures, if they could catch one. The continual hide-and-seek existence between both species, gave rise to the phrase "a game of jran and wenton" which indicated series of events in which one party tried to avoid contact with the pursuing party.
